issue_request: FHIR-17627 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Patient after a PA vote, asking that Patient-example-a use family "Duck" and given "Donald" instead of the reversed family "Donald" and given "Duck". The Jira resolution said the example would be updated as noted.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation by source commit 7527ea0280826119906c2c2a8daaed823b4d7f10 (#FHIR-17627 update example resource), which changed source/patient/patient-example-a.xml from family Donald/given Duck to family Duck/given Donald. Blame on the current source still points the corrected family and given lines at that commit.
additional_context: The current FHIR build scope includes Patient as an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and source/patient/list-Patient-examples.xml includes patient-example-a as the Patient/pat1 example, so source/patient/patient-example-a.xml is the authoritative example input for the requested generated JSON. No checked-in patient-example-a JSON source exists to edit separately. Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no later or conflicting decision requiring another source change.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current Patient example source already has <family value="Duck"/> and <given value="Donald"/>, satisfying the published Jira request.
